=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:
Use the provided adult Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's facial identity, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, large sword design, and overall warrior appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

Riven is now an adult and has trained for many years.
She is already a skilled swordswoman with strong balance, fast reactions, and confident control of her large sword.

Do not redesign her clothing.
Do not redesign or replace her sword.
Do not change her hairstyle or body proportions.


FATHER:
Use the provided Father reference image as the strict character reference.

Preserve his facial identity, age, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He is an experienced former warrior and Riven's father.
His movements are calm, economical, controlled, and confident.

He is not trying to defeat or hurt Riven.
He is teaching her through controlled sword attacks.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are exactly TWO human characters in this scene:

1. Adult Riven
2. Her father

No other person, soldier, enemy, creature, monster, animal, or additional character appears.

Riven and Father train ONLY with each other.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environment reference.

The scene takes place in the familiar training yard beside Riven's family cottage in the poor mountain village.

Preserve the recognizable cottage, dirt-and-grass yard, wooden fence, old tree, chopping area, surrounding valley, and distant mountains.

Natural daylight.
Quiet village atmosphere.
Gentle wind moving hair, clothing, grass, and leaves.

This is a peaceful training session at home, not a battlefield.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.
16:9 cinematic widescreen.
Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.
Natural human movement.
Grounded sword movement with believable weight and momentum.
Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Keep the sword training simple, readable, and natural.

Do not overcomplicate the choreography.
Do not create elaborate combinations.
Do not turn the training into an aggressive duel.

Father is primarily the attacker and teacher.
Riven is primarily reacting, defending, observing, and learning.

All character dialogue in this video must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.
Use clear natural English pronunciation.
Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.
Do not translate the dialogue.
No additional spoken dialogue.
No background conversations.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No text.
No watermark.
No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

This scene is a sword lesson between an experienced father and his adult daughter.

Father is teaching Riven how to read an opponent rather than simply watching the opponent's weapon.

Father controls the pace of the lesson.

He initiates a few simple, controlled sword attacks while Riven responds defensively with her large sword.

The exchanges should feel like natural training between two people who have practiced together for many years.

Father remains calm and observant throughout the lesson.

Riven is already highly skilled, but Father is teaching her a more subtle principle.

There is no winner and no loser.

Nobody is disarmed.
Nobody falls.
Nobody is injured.

The purpose of the scene is TEACHING, not winning.


=== SCENES ===

SHOT 1 — TRAINING

Begin with a clear cinematic medium-wide view of Adult Riven and Father training together in the familiar yard.

Make both characters clearly visible and visually distinct.

Father calmly initiates the training.

He gives Riven a controlled sword attack.

Riven reacts naturally and blocks with her large sword.

CLANG.

Father continues the lesson with another simple controlled attack.

Riven responds successfully again.

Their movement is skilled and believable, but restrained.

This is familiar father-and-daughter training, not a real fight.


SHOT 2 — THE LESSON

During the training, Father notices that Riven is concentrating too much on his sword.

He stops the exchange briefly.

Father looks directly at Riven and says:

"Don't watch the blade."

Riven listens carefully.

Father continues:

"Watch me."

Riven's attention changes.

Instead of staring at Father's sword, she begins watching Father's posture, shoulders, eyes, and body movement.

Father resumes the lesson with another controlled attack.

Do not prescribe an exact attack pattern.

Allow the movement to remain simple and natural.

This time Riven reads Father's intention earlier and responds more confidently.

Father immediately recognizes that she understood the lesson.


SHOT 3 — AGAIN

The exchange naturally stops.

Neither character has won.

Neither character is exhausted or injured.

Father calmly observes Riven.

Riven realizes what changed.

A subtle confident smile appears on her face.

She looks at Father and asks:

"Again?"

Father gives a restrained approving look.

He answers:

"Again."

Father calmly prepares to continue teaching.

Riven raises her large sword and focuses on Father rather than his weapon.

Both are ready to continue training.

CUT before another exchange begins.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven and Father are still in the training yard beside their cottage.

Both are unharmed.

Riven still has her original large sword from the provided reference.

Father remains her teacher rather than her opponent.

Riven has understood the lesson:

Do not focus only on the weapon.
Read the person wielding it.

The scene ends with both of them ready to continue training, but no further sword exchange begins.


=== MOOD ===

Grounded.
Warm but restrained.
Skilled.
Focused.
Natural father-and-daughter familiarity.

The relationship should be expressed mainly through the training itself rather than sentimentality.

Father teaches through action.
Riven learns quickly.

This is not a dramatic duel.
This is not a competition.
This is not a battle.
